# PEI Private Credit: Small deals, big funds: The Crescent recipe


##### September 2026 – Growth doesn’t have to mean moving up-market. Crescent’s longstanding focus on the lower middle market has helped drive the continued growth of its direct lending platform, culminating this year in the largest fundraise in the firm’s history, explains CEO and President Chris Wright in this month’s issue of PEI Private Credit. Read more from his interview with PEI’s Andy Thomson.
